data.gender_notes: Thirunavukkarasu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Thirunavukkarasu means 'Lord of the Temple'. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is used in Hinduism. The name Thirunavukkarasu carries the meaning “Lord of the Temple” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Thirunavukkarasu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the temple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thirunavukkarasu is a revered name in Hinduism, symbolizing the divine power and wisdom of the Lord of the Temple.
data.etymology: Thirunavukkarasu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Temple.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thirunavukkarasu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Thirunavukkarasu is a revered name in Hindu culture, which underlines the significance of temples in our social and spiritual heritage. The name pays homage to the deity who resides in the temple and is believed to be the protector of devotees. It is a name that reminds us of the importance of seeking solace and guidance in religious places.
data.spiritual_significance: Thirunavukkarasu is a powerful spiritual name that signifies surrender and devotion to the Divine. It signifies the belief that God resides in temples and that one can connect with the Divine by visiting temples and offering prayers. The name also signifies the belief that the deity in the temple is a savior and protector, and that seeking refuge in the deity can bring peace and solace. The name Thirunavukkarasu encourages us to turn inwards and seek spiritual guidance and strength, no matter what challenges we might face in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Thirunavukkarasu is a revered name in Hinduism, meaning 'the one who worships the sacred serpent, Adisesha'. This name symbolizes devotion, protection, and enlightenment, representing one's commitment to seeking wisdom and protection under the divine serpent's shelter.

historical_references.reference: Thirunavukkarasu was a prominent Hindu saint, poet, philosopher and scholar in the 8th century AD in Tamil Nadu, India. He is considered an incarnation of Lord Murugan. Thirunavukkarasu's poems are found in the Tirumurai, a collection of 27 Tamil Agama scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Thirunavukkarasu is also known for his role in the Tamil Alvar tradition, a major Hindu devotional movement in southern India. He is revered as a saint and is believed to have composed numerous hymns in praise of Lord Murugan.
historical_references.context: Tamil Alvar tradition, southern India, Hindu devotional movement, Lord Murugan

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
